To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the workshop approach was adapted for professional development at a school site; (2) teachers' TPACK was developed as they planned and taught a blog activity; and (3) teachers' TCK was developed more than PCK and TPK.
the TPACK based professional development was successful in helping the teachers learn to teach with blogs in science.
the teachers developed TPACK in the context of the blog activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how teachers can be supported to develop their TPACK.
how teachers' professional development can be designed in ways that are consistent with current knowledge of teacher learning and the development of TPACK.
the design of a TPACK based approach to professional development for science teachers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this case study illustrates how the TPACK framework can be used as a basis for the design and delivery of professional development for science teachers.
TPACK can be developed through a combination workshop experiences and immediate implementation of knowledge gained in workshops into practice in the classroom.

the TPACK based approach to professional development was a success in that teachers were able to plan and implement an activity with technology in science and they developed knowledge of how to teach science with technology.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TPACK framework provides a useful lens to guide the design of professional development for science teachers and the analysis of teachers' experiences in the professional development process.

teachers' TPACK development is a process of learning and applying new knowledge in the context of the classroom and that teachers' TPK is developed through the process of planning and implementing a blog activity.
TPACK is a framework that can be used as an effective tool to guide the design and implementation of professional development for science teachers.
The main takeaway from our work is that

TPACK is an appropriate framework for designing professional development for science teachers and that a TPACK based professional development model can be successfully adapted to meet the needs of a school site.

the TPACK framework can serve as a useful tool for professional developers and teachers to reflect on the complex nature of teaching with technology and to design effective technology enhanced professional development programs.
a workshop approach based upon TPACK can be used as an effective means for professional development for science teachers to learn how to teach with blogs.
